description: Zero-trust hub-spoke network on Azure with Azure Firewall, private endpoints for all PaaS data planes, conditional access enforced via Entra ID, just-in-time admin access, and micro-segmented subnets per application tier.
constraints: Default deny between spokes except via approved private endpoints
No legacy VPN full-tunnel bypass of inspection
Privileged access workstation required for production changes
All admin actions logged to immutable audit store
requiredCapabilities: Azure Virtual WAN or hub VNet with Azure Firewall
Azure Private Link for PaaS services
assumptions: Identity is the primary perimeter; network controls are defense in depth
East-west traffic inspected where policy requires
